dedupe_keys.name: inputs to gcam usa for im3 phase 2 experiments

description: This data set holds the XML input files for the IM3 Phase 2 version of GCAM-USA, the state-level US version of the Global Change Analysis Model. It was published by Mengqi Zhao and co-authors of the Integrated Multisector, Multiscale Modeling (IM3) project. Scenario-specific inputs give water availability by HUC2 basin under RCP4.5 and RCP8.5, monthly day and night heating and cooling degree-hours by state, agricultural productivity changes and an RCP4.5 emissions constraint, for eight canonical scenarios crossing hotter and cooler climate variants with SSP3 and SSP5. Model-improvement inputs extend GCAM-USA version 5.3 with updated coal plant retirement schedules, retirement dates for the Diablo Canyon and Palisades nuclear plants, electricity trade limited to the ERCOT, WECC and Eastern interconnections, offshore carbon storage costs and groundwater depletion limits. Coverage is the United States by state and basin. Files are XML inputs downloadable from MSD-LIVE under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost, for use with the IM3 GCAM-USA code on GitHub. Caveats: the files are inputs only and need the matching model version, and the retirement data reflect assumptions at publication. Simulation uses are long-term energy and power system planning under climate and socioeconomic scenarios. Related records: data-gcam-usa-godeeep-scenarios holds other GCAM-USA scenario outputs.
